title: The 5 Best Stocks in Bill Gates’s Portfolio
summary: Key TakeawaysThe Gates Foundation Trust’s latest 13F shows it held Caterpillar, FedEx, Ecolab, Deere and Canadian National Railway without change last quarter, and together they make up more than half of its US stocks. They’re its five positions of 2% or more where analysts’ average price targets sit furthest above today’s prices, from 41% for Caterpillar to 6% for Canadian National.
